# Site packages glossary

This page explains the words used across the site packages help. Each entry names where the term comes from in the
code or the packages and links the page that explains it in full.

![Setup, Packages](../images/help/sp-glossary.webp)

## Contents

1. [Packages and their files](#packages-and-their-files)
2. [Where packages are kept](#where-packages-are-kept)
3. [Installing](#installing)
4. [The package server](#the-package-server)
5. [Tools](#tools)
6. [Related pages](#related-pages)

## Packages and their files

| Term | Meaning | More |
|---|---|---|
| **Package** | A folder with a `package.xml` and the files it names: content classes, content objects, extensions, settings files, images, documents | [What a site installer package is](basics/what-a-site-installer-package-is.md) |
| **`.ezpkg`** | One package as a single file: a gzip compressed tar of the package folder, `package.xml` at the top. The upload also accepts `.tar.gz` and `.tgz` (`package.ini [UploadSettings] AllowedSuffixes[]`) | [The .ezpkg file](basics/the-ezpkg-file.md) |
| **`package.xml`** | The package definition: name, summary, description, vendor, type, version, maintainers, license, documents, changelog, files, dependencies, settings files, install and uninstall items | [package.xml reference](basics/package-xml-reference.md) |
| **`package.json`** | The definition in the JSON package format, an alternative to `package.xml` with checksums of every file | [Classic and JSON packages](basics/classic-and-json-packages.md) |
| **Package type** | The `<type value="..."/>` of a package. The index of 6.0.15 uses `site`, `contentclass`, `contentobject`, `sitestyle` and `extension`; `package.ini [PackageSettings] TypeList[]` names the types the administration lists | [Package types](basics/package-types.md) |
| **Site package** | A package of type `site`: the starting point of a new installation, offered by the setup wizard. It requires other packages and can carry install scripts | [What a site installer package is](basics/what-a-site-installer-package-is.md) |
| **Site style** | A package of type `sitestyle`: a design (style sheets and images) for a site package, such as `sevenx_design_blue` | [Package types](basics/package-types.md) |
| **Demo content package** | A `contentobject` package with the sample content of a site package, such as `sevenx_multisite_democontent` | [The demo content packages](sevenx-multisite/the-demo-content-packages.md) |
| **Clean package** | A site package whose name ends in `_clean`: the same site without the demo articles and images | [The clean variant and sevenx_site](sevenx-multisite/the-clean-variant-and-sevenx-site.md) |
| **Install item** | One step of `<install>` in `package.xml`, carried out by a package handler (a class, an object list, an extension, a SQL file ...) | [Install items and handlers](basics/install-items-and-handlers.md) |
| **Package handler** | The kernel class that installs one kind of install item, named in `package.ini [PackageSettings] HandlerAlias[]`, for example `ezcontentclass` = `eZContentClassPackageHandler` | [Install items and handlers](basics/install-items-and-handlers.md) |
| **Dependency** | A `<require type="ezpackage" name="..." min-version="..."/>` in `<dependencies><requires>`: a package that must be there too | [Dependencies and the install order](basics/dependencies-and-install-order.md) |
| **Install script** | A PHP file a site package lists in `<settings><settings-file>`, run by the installer while the site is created: siteaccess settings, roles, preferences, the multisite installer | [Install scripts in a site package](basics/install-scripts-in-a-site-package.md) |
| **`LICENCE`** | The license text a package carries in `documents/` and names in `<documents>`; the element is `<licence>` (both keep their historical spelling) | [License and documents](requirements/license-and-documents.md) |

## Where packages are kept

| Term | Meaning | More |
|---|---|---|
| **Repository** | A folder below `var/storage/packages/` that holds packages: `local` for packages made or imported here, and one per vendor | [The local package repository](basics/the-local-package-repository.md) |
| **Vendor** | The `<vendor>` of a package; it decides the repository folder (`7x`, `ez-systems`). `package.ini [RepositorySettings] Vendor=7x` is the setup wizard's repository | [The local package repository](basics/the-local-package-repository.md) |
| **Installer source** | A package the setup wizard depends on: in the wizard's repository, a site package, or required by one. Marked in Setup > Packages; removing one needs an extra confirmation | [Packages guide, 4. Installer sources](../../guides/packages.md#4-installer-sources) |
| **Source repository** | The Git repository with the unpacked folders a package is built from, such as `se7enxweb/sevenx-ezpackage` | [The source repositories](package-server/the-source-repositories.md) |

## Installing

| Term | Meaning | More |
|---|---|---|
| **Import** | Unpack a package into a repository without changing the site | [Import versus install](basics/import-versus-install.md) |
| **Install** | Carry out a package's install items, so its classes, content and files are created on the site | [Installing and uninstalling](admin-gui/installing-and-uninstalling.md) |
| **Setup wizard** | The installer in the browser; its site types and site packages steps download and import packages | [How the setup wizard uses packages](basics/how-the-setup-wizard-uses-packages.md) |
| **Kickstarter, `exp:install`** | The installers without a browser; they take the site package's name from `kickstart.ini` or `--package` | [How the kickstarter and the console use packages](basics/how-the-kickstarter-and-console-use-packages.md) |
| **Multisite installer** | The install script `sevenx-multi-site-installer.php` of `sevenx_multisite` (and its counterpart `cjw-multi-site-installer.php` of `cjw_multisite`) that builds the sites, siteaccesses and settings | [The multisite installer script](sevenx-multisite/the-multisite-installer-script.md) |

## The package server

| Term | Meaning | More |
|---|---|---|
| **Package server** | A static HTTPS site that publishes `.ezpkg` files and an `index.xml` per Exponential release; the default is `exponential.packages.exponential.earth` | [What the package server is](package-server/what-the-package-server-is.md) |
| **`index.xml`** | The list of the packages of one release: a `<packages vendor="7x">` root with one `<package>` element per package (name, type, URL; site packages also version, summary, description, thumbnail) | [The index.xml format](package-server/the-index-xml-format.md) |
| **`RemotePackagesIndexURL`** | `package.ini [RepositorySettings]`: the folder whose `index.xml` the setup wizard reads. When empty, `RemotePackagesIndexURLBase` plus the version is used | [Package server settings](package-server/package-server-settings.md) |
| **Mirror** | A copy of a release folder on another server or on disk, used for offline installs or your own packages | [Offline installs and mirrors](package-server/offline-installs-and-mirrors.md) |

## Tools

| Term | Meaning | More |
|---|---|---|
| **Setup > Packages** | The package pages of the administration (`/package/list`) | [Packages in the administration](admin-gui/README.md) |
| **Package wizard** | **Create new package** in Setup > Packages: content object, content class, extension and site style packages | [The package wizard](admin-gui/the-package-wizard.md) |
| **`ezpm.php`** | The package manager on the command line, in the installation root | [Creating packages with ezpm](your-own/creating-packages-with-ezpm.md) |
| **`build.sh`** | The script in a source repository that packs every package folder into an `.ezpkg` | [Rebuilding with build.sh](your-own/rebuilding-with-build-sh.md) |
| **ezupdate** | The extension behind **Setup > Updates and packages**; its package servers page lists and adds `.ezpkg` servers | [Package servers in ezupdate](admin-gui/package-servers-in-ezupdate.md) |
